description: Run an async BAMF research brief job over a topic, source URLs, and/or notes. Use it when current/recent facts, benchmark data, trends, or source-backed visual claims would strengthen a post. BAMF uses live web search (treg) when available and returns copy-fit facts, post angles, and a knowledge-doc handoff instead of a raw data dump.

use_perplexity.description: Deprecated alias of use_web_research; removed after one release.

use_web_research.description: Use BAMF's web current-research path when available.

name: bamf.run_research
